title: Integration test file is unformatted — fails CI format gate
evidence:
let assert Ok(entry) =
    list.find(response.entries, fn(e) { e.id == app_id })

(diff after gleam format:)
-  let assert Ok(entry) =
-    list.find(response.entries, fn(e) { e.id == app_id })
+  let assert Ok(entry) = list.find(response.entries, fn(e) { e.id == app_id })
detail: The let-binding is split across two lines; gleam format wants it on one line. Violates the mandatory pre-PR `make format` gate (AGENTS.md). CI format-check fails on this head sha.
recommended_fix: Run `gleam format server/test/integration/application_integration_test.gleam` and amend the commit.

title: List handler duplicates application.status_from_string with its own inline string→enum case
detail: The list handler, client reducer, and shared status_from_string all independently map status strings to variants. The r1 B1 occurred precisely because an arm was added to the shared function but forgotten here. The warning log is the only architectural difference; future status additions remain at risk of the same drift.
recommended_fix: Consider replacing the inline case with application.status_from_string + a separate unknown-guard wrapping the call for the log, eliminating the arm-count mismatch risk.
